basics.name: Laxmi Narsimha Reddy Jammula
basics.label: Hands-on Architect & Engineering Leader
basics.summary: Hands-on architect and engineering leader with 14+ years building enterprise systems in Go, Java, C#, Python, and JavaScript: 8+ years as an engineer and data scientist shipping ML models into production, then 5+ years leading engineering teams while owning the architecture decisions — data stores, event-driven systems on Kafka, API contracts, production incident response. In 2026, building and running agentic AI systems: buildgate, an open-source agent factory with a permanent human merge gate, plus coding-agent harness hardening, benchmarks, and local LLM infrastructure.

projects.name: buildgate
projects.description: Open-source agent factory: ticket and spec in, sandboxed build-and-verify loop, human-reviewed pull request out.
highlights: Built buildgate, an open-source agent factory: a ticket and a spec go in, a coding agent works through a sandboxed build-and-verify loop, and a human gets a reviewable pull request. Merge and deploy stay human by design.
Go orchestration on Temporal, a sandbox runtime with per-run network egress control and a spend meter, a React operator console, and an MCP endpoint for agents.

A written safety contract whose invariants each map to the test that enforces them; measured by how many real tickets reach an accepted pull request with no human intervention, on Go, Python, Java, Ruby, and React Native repositories.

projects.name: Coding-agent harness engineering & evaluation
projects.description: Harness hardening for the pi coding agent, and controlled benchmarks of four agent harnesses.
highlights: Harden and customize the Pi coding-agent harness for daily use: a pinned TypeScript contract test suite, a current-diff quality gate, project-scoped configuration overlays, stack-aware routing, an external-effect guard, symlink-safe path checks, versioned trace records, and a Docker containment profile.

Design and run controlled agentic-coding benchmarks (Harbor framework, blinded model-based review, replicated trials) comparing four agent harnesses — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI, and Pi — across Go and Flutter/Dart tasks; also evaluates OpenClaw as a fifth.

Diagnosed a decoding-configuration regression (disabled reasoning, undocumented greedy decoding) that flipped a replicated coding-benchmark result from 0/4 to 4/4, and built supporting evaluation tooling (stall detection, wall-clock budget nudging) used in later runs.
